basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast who recently stumbled into the vast world of Reddit. Originally from Ohio, I'm currently living in Dayton and working as a junior developer at a local startup. When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring new video games, especially Super Smash Bros, and catching up on episodes of Riverdale. I'm single and usually online during the evenings, particularly after 7 PM, but I often peek at Reddit during lunch breaks too. I'm still learning the ropes around here, so I'm open to advice and tips from seasoned Redditors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is mostly self-taught. I developed an interest in technology and coding during high school, which led me to pursue online courses and tutorials. I try to keep up with the latest trends in cryptocurrency and tech advancements by frequently browsing subreddits like CryptoCurrency.
